samples.name: Toyota 2000GT White
samples.shortDescription: Toyota 2000GT White is a 1:32 Aoshima model kit focused on the Toyota 2000GT in White, with the real vehicle's character brought into a compact display build.
samples.description:
Toyota 2000GT White keeps the current Aoshima display-kit positioning, but gives the page more useful context around the subject. The Toyota 2000GT is one of Japan's landmark sports cars, remembered for its long-bonnet coupe profile, Yamaha-linked engineering story and rare 1960s grand-touring character.

The canonical scale is 1:32. This listing is the White variant. It suits builders who want a recognisable automotive or screen-vehicle subject without the product page relying on unverified kit-part claims.
